Subject: Setup prerequisites: BlueTide Payments vendor record & tax paperwork

Hi Asha,

Thanks for starting the vendor onboarding for BlueTide. To get a PO created and vendor record live in our system we need a short set of items from you. For non-US entities we require either a completed W-8BEN-E or a W-9 (if the vendor is a US entity), plus a bank letter showing account name and routing/SWIFT. Specifically for BlueTide we need:

- Completed W-8BEN-E (signed).
- A bank letter on bank letterhead confirming account ownership and SWIFT/BIC.
- Beneficial ownership declaration if your legal entity is a subsidiary (only if applicable).

Can you send the completed W-8BEN-E and the bank letter as PDF attachments? If you have a notarized W-8BEN-E (depending on country), please include that — it speeds the tax clearance process.

If there's a preferred billing contact or PO reference you want us to include, reply with that and we will surface it in the PO. Our target SLA for this stage is 5 business days once we have all documents.

Thanks,

Monica Patel
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Asha —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for uploading the signed documents. A couple of follow-ups from our side after a brief review with Finance:

1) Bank letter: looks good, includes account name and SWIFT which is what we need for ACH/wires.
2) W-8BEN-E: because BlueTide is Cyprus-registered and will receive US-sourced payments in some cases, our tax team sometimes requires either:
   - a notarized W-8BEN-E (notarization on the signature page), or
   - an authorities-verified bank letter showing the entity tax ID alongside the account, or
   - an official signed and dated confirmation from your tax advisor alongside the W-8BEN-E.

Grace (cc) — can you confirm which of the above is acceptable to AP in this instance? If notarization is required we can issue a quick lookup for local notary guidance.

Asha — if notarization is easiest for you, please send the notarized PDF; if you prefer the bank to include the tax ID on their letter, that will also work. Once we have that we can create the PO.

Quoting your note: ">
We have included a signed copy of the W-8BEN-E (notarization is not typical for us, but we can get it notarized if Redwood needs it).
